features: Available in 1.3, 1080p, 3 and 5 megapixel, color or day/night
Integrated H.264 compact MegaVideo camera, 3.3-12 mm IR-corrected lens and 2-axis gimbal
Dual encoder H.264 (MPEG-4 Part 10) and MJPEG
